text:
Predicates:
InfectiousDisease(x) ::: x is an infectious disease.
CausedBy(x, y) ::: x is caused by y.
OccursIn(x, y) ::: x occurs in y.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
Symptom(x, y) ::: y is a symptom of x.
Feel(x, y) ::: x feels y.
Premises:
InfectiousDisease(monkeypox) ∧ CausedBy(monkeypox, monkeypoxVirus) ::: Monkeypox is an infectious disease caused by the monkeypox virus.
∀x (OccursIn(monkeypoxVirus, x) → Animal(x)) ::: Monkeypox virus can occur in certain animals, including humans.
Human(human) ∧ Mammal(mammal) ::: Humans are mammals.
∀x (Mammal(x) → Animal(x)) ::: Mammals are animals.
Symptom(monkeypox, fever) ∧ Symptom(monkeypox, headache) ∧ Symptom(monkeypox, musclePains) ∧ Symptom(monkeypox, feelingTired) ::: Symptoms of Monkeypox include fever, headache, muscle pains, feeling tired, and so on.
Feel(people, tired) ∧ Get(people, glu) ::: People feel tired when they get a glu.
Conclusion:
∃x Animal(x) ::: There is an animal.
